Container.Name: chub
Container.Overview:
CHUB — Chodeus' Media Script Hub. Self-hosted, all-in-one media asset manager for your Plex/ARR stack.
Bundles a React web UI and a FastAPI backend that orchestrates scheduled modules (poster_renamerr, jduparr, nohl, unmatched_assets, upgradinatorr, labelarr, sync_gdrive, border_replacerr, nestarr, poster_cleanarr, renameinatorr, health_checkarr) against your libraries, poster trees, and cloud drives.
Web UI on container port 8000; login is bcrypt + JWT with rate limiting (first boot prompts you to create the admin account).
Config help: https://github.com/chodeus/chub/wiki/Configuration

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Path where config.yml, chub.db, and logs are stored.

Config.Name: Kometa Assets Path
Config.Description: Path to your Kometa assets directory (poster_renamerr source tree for collection images).

Config.Name: Media Path
Config.Description: Path to your media library (root of movies / tv folders).

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Shared data mount (useful for nohl / jduparr cross-volume walks).

Config.Name: Plex Metadata Path
Config.Description: Path to the Plex Media Server metadata directory (required by poster_cleanarr for orphan cleanup).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Container-side is always 8000; change the host side to avoid conflicts.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: umask applied to files written by CHUB.
